section_1.title: Prerequisites: The Vector Space Concept
section_1.content: Introduce embeddings as coordinate points. Explain that machines don't understand words, but can calculate 'distance' between numerical vectors representing concepts.
section_1.example: Represent 'Cat' and 'Dog' as points close together on a 2D graph, while 'Robot' is placed far away.

section_2.title: The Transformer Core: Attention Mechanism
section_2.content: Explain the 'Self-Attention' mechanism visually: instead of reading linearly, the model assigns weights (importance) to all words in a sentence simultaneously.
section_2.example: In the sentence 'The animal didn't cross the street because it was too tired', visualize lines connecting 'it' to 'animal' with thicker glow lines to show semantic focus.

section_3.title: Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM
section_3.content: Discuss the 'Large' in LLM. Explain how stacking Transformer layers allows the model to capture complex relationships like syntax, nuance, and logic.
section_3.example: A single Transformer block is like a library index card; an LLM is the entire library with thousands of cross-referenced shelves.

section_4.title: The Training Loop: Predicting the Next Token
section_4.content: Show the training process: the model receives a partial sequence and adjusts internal weights to minimize the error of the predicted next word.
section_4.example: A 'Robot Teacher' providing an exam where the prompt is 'The sky is...' and the model gets 'blue' right; if it says 'green', it self-corrects via backpropagation.

section_5.title: Real-world Application: Generative AI
section_5.content: Synthesize how the previous concepts allow an LLM to generate creative content by sampling probabilities of the next probable tokens.
section_5.example: Imagine a chatbot 'Chef-Bot' deciding between adding 'salt' or 'sugar' to a sentence about cooking, based on its training on millions of recipes.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Map to right side of screen
                x = 2.0 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):

        self.setup_layout("Prerequisites: The Vector Space Concept", 
                          ["Embeddings map words to coordinate points.", 
                           "Machines calculate distance between these vectors.",

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Create grid and two icons representing "Cat" and "Dog"
        cat_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/machine.svg")
        dog_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/machine.svg")
        
        self.place_at_grid(cat_icon, 'C2', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.place_at_grid(dog_icon, 'D4', scale_factor=0.5)
        
        cat_label = Text("Cat", font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(cat_icon, UP, buff=0.1)
        dog_label = Text("Dog", font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(dog_icon, UP, buff=0.1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Move the two points closer together
        new_cat_pos = self.grid['C3']

        self.play(

            dog_icon.animate.move_to(new_dog_pos),

            UpdateFromFunc(dist_line, lambda m: m.put_start_and_end_on(cat_icon.get_center(), dog_icon.get_center()))
        )
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"))
        self.wait(1)

            "Attention allows models to read words simultaneously.",
            "It assigns importance weights to every word.",
            "Context clarifies relationships between distant words.",
            "The model focuses on relevant connections.",
            "Complex sentence structure becomes understandable."
        ])
        
        # Assets
        book = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/book.svg")

        self.play(
            lines[1].animate.set_color("#00FF00").set_stroke(width=6),
            lines[0].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF").set_stroke(width=2)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#FFFFFF")
        self.play(FadeOut(words), FadeOut(lines), FadeOut(book))
        self.place_at_grid(brain, 'C3', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(brain))
        self.wait(2)
